identification: William Menzies Gibb (1859-1931, Scottish-born New Zealand painter, son of John Gibb), watercolour, Otira Gorge on the West Coast Road (NZ): river below steep bush-clad walls with snow peak behind, a red Cobb & Co coach on the cut road at the bluff, 28 x 21 cm, signed lower right 'W. Menzies Gibb'. Framed with cream mat in a dark/gilt frame. Armitage catalogues it as 'W. Menzies-Gibb, Gorge Scene' without the NZ attribution. Genuine-looking period watercolour (washes, scratching-out highlights).
